German Chancellor Merz Vows to Continue Reforms After Election Loss

German Chancellor Friedrich Merz described the results of a state election as a 'disaster' but stated he would remain in office and continue with his reform agenda. Despite a historic defeat in the state election, Merz vowed to press ahead with reforms.
